mapper.sql: id, user_id, content, images, like_count, comment_count, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_post (user_id, content, images) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{images})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM community_post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.deleted, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM community_post p JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT FROM community_post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET like_count = #{likeCount} WHERE id = #{id}
